rule.title: A security deposit to be returned is not rent

when_missing.because: Rent received is rent unless a preparer says it is a deposit to be returned

citation.wording: Don’t include a security deposit in your income when you receive it if you plan to return it to your tenant at the end of the lease.

rule.open_point: The other inclusions Publication 527 lists (advance rent, expenses a tenant pays, property or services received as rent) ADD to rent: the client's rent item already holds whatever they recorded, and no rule may create a figure, so they are not applied here.
